mapper.insert: INSERT INTO incident_data_purge ( id, incident_id, status, closed_at, purge_due_at, version, environment_policy, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{id, typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}, #{incidentId, typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}, #{status}, #{closedAt}, #{purgeDueAt}, 1, #{environmentPolicy}, #{now}, #{now} ) ON CONFLICT (incident_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT id, incident_id, status, closed_at, purge_due_at, completed_at, last_error_code, version, environment_policy, created_at, updated_at FROM incident_data_purge WHERE incident_id = #{incidentId, typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}
mapper.update: UPDATE incident_data_purge SET status = #{status}, last_error_code = #{lastErrorCode}, completed_at = #{completedAt}, environment_policy = #{environmentPolicy}, version = #{version}, updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{purgeRunId, typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}
mapper.select: SELECT purge_run_id, hook_name, status, purged_count, retained_count, error_code, completed_at, updated_at FROM incident_data_purge_hook_step WHERE purge_run_id = #{purgeRunId, typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler} ORDER BY hook_name ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO incident_data_purge_hook_step ( purge_run_id, hook_name, status, purged_count, retained_count, error_code, completed_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{purgeRunId, typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}, #{hookName}, #{status}, #{purgedCount}, #{retainedCount}, #{errorCode}, #{completedAt}, #{now} ) ON CONFLICT (purge_run_id, hook_name) DO UPDATE SET status = EXCLUDED.status, purged_count = EXCLUDED.purged_count, retained_count = EXCLUDED.retained_count, error_code = EXCLUDED.error_code, completed_at = EXCLUDED.completed_at, updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at
